title: Candidate
description: Normalized candidate record based on candidates_cleaned.csv. Blank optional CSV values become JSON null.

name.description: Candidate name; required by the dataset.

email.description: Optional email; duplicate review only, never a matching feature.

phone.description: Optional phone stored as text; duplicate review only, never a matching feature.

location.description: Optional location; not used for matching.

skills.description: Canonical skills array. CSV semicolon-separated skills are converted to an array.

source.description: Optional candidate source; not used for matching.
